# Hebrew chatbot builder — conversational AI bots in Hebrew: WhatsApp, Telegram, RTL web widgets

Curated by Skill Harbor — @skills-il's hebrew-chatbot-builder skill: a deep, production-grade playbook for conversational AI chatbots with native Hebrew support. The agent follows a six-step procedure — identify the platform (WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Telegram, or web widget), confirm formal vs informal register, choose a gender-handling strategy (ask early, gender-neutral phrasing, or slash notation), scaffold from the bundled scripts (whatsapp-webhook-handler.py with signature verification, telegram-bot-scaffold.py), wire Israeli entity extraction (phone numbers, shekel amounts, dates, Teudat Zehut with check-digit validation), and verify RTL rendering on real devices. It goes far beyond templates: Hebrew conversation design (register choice, gender-aware responses, date/time formatting), WhatsApp template setup and interactive buttons/lists, Telegram BotFather setup and inline keyboards, an RTL CSS chat widget (bubbles, typing indicator, mixed Hebrew/English direction detection), Hebrew NLP patterns (intent lexicons, entity regexes with documented caveats, LLM-based classification guidance, prompt-injection guards), a full conversation-flow state machine with Hebrew fallback handling and human handoff, and a "gotchas" section that reads like hard-won experience (webhook signature verification must fail closed, never ship app.run(debug=True), nine-digit runs are not Teudat Zehuts). Honest caveats: genuinely Hebrew-only — explicitly not for non-Hebrew bots; WhatsApp...
